meta.notes: One entry per URL. status: live = indexable, in sitemap and hubs; draft = page exists but noindex, not in sitemap or hubs; planned = no page is created. Only the owner's OK moves a page to live (CLAUDE.md §8). type picks the template: home, utility, hub, tool, article. Body lives in content/<slug>.php (home uses content/home.php). group (articles only) picks the section on /guides; sections follow meta.articleGroups. problems (tools only) lists troubleshooting slugs shown as 'Common problems' in the What to do next box; problemLabel is the short anchor used there.
